title: Link a WhatsApp group to a company, and ticks on group messages
text: A group chat now has a bar above it where you can link the group to a company. Once linked, creating a task, service or invoice from the chat, team discussion and notes attach to that company. Your messages in a group also show delivered and read ticks. In a group the tick means at least one member received or read it; the hover text says so.
points: Link a group to a company
Tasks and invoices attach to that company
stepsTitle: Linking a group to a company

steps.name: Open a group chat
steps.detail: A bar shows above the messages.

steps.name: Press Link to a company
steps.detail: Search the company name and pick it.

steps.name: Use the three dots on a message
steps.detail: Create task, service or invoice for that company.
